snippet.title: TETRIS Maniac Gameplay - PS3
snippet.description:
TETRIS Maniac Gameplay - PS3

FOLLOW ME ON FACEBOOK: https://www.facebook.com/ShackredVideoGames

SUBSCRIBE: http://www.youtube.com/c/shackred?sub_confirmation=1

An enhanced version of the PSP Minis release of this classic puzzler, EA's Tetris offers a variety of ways to play one of the most popular games ever made. Experience the most vibrant Tetris ever with enhanced 1080P HD graphics, 5.1 Surround Sound, 6 multiplayer modes, and 3 brand new game modes that are exclusive to the PS3.


#tetris #videogames #ign
